data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kese', meaning grace or beauty. In Christian tradition, the name Cesya represents the divine grace and beauty bestowed upon an individual. The name Cesya carries the meaning “Grace, beauty” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cesya usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
